headline: BYD Plans New European EV Plants to Circumvent Stricter Trade Barriers
summary: BYD will construct new factories across Europe to expand regional market share and navigate tariffs targeting Chinese electric vehicles alongside domestic subsidy pullbacks, according to vice-president Liu Xueliang.
why: BYD is the world's largest electric vehicle manufacturer; building localized assembly helps it mitigate EU import tariffs on Chinese-made automobiles.

impacts.name: BYD Company Limited
impacts.why: Local European manufacturing helps bypass rising vehicle import tariffs and protects European sales growth.

impacts.name: European Automotive
impacts.why: Increased local production from BYD intensifies competition for European legacy carmakers.
